wire_contract.alignment: Natural C++ alignment; every implicit gap is named reserved_padding and zero on encode. Sizes and offsets include all reserved storage.
wire_contract.publication: SPSC ring indices use acquire/release atomic loads/stores. Fast-control seqlock slots begin with one aligned 64-bit sequence followed by atomic 64-bit payload words; odd means writer active, equal even sequences before/after acquire reads mean stable. Codecs operate only on private copies, never directly on concurrent shared memory.
wire_contract.compatibility: Transport admission requires minor 15. Minor 15 expands named I/O to sixteen channels per direction, adds fenced manual output commands uses the previously reserved final trajectory-point word for upper-eight I/O marker bits, and appends stationary input-wait metadata (320-byte TrajectoryPointV1 with scoped input-monitor masks). All direct IPC clients must be rebuilt together. Minor 13 added explicit opt-in verified-delta restoration of v3 HM35 anchors. Minor 14 adds the additive path jog lane: jog_operations path_begin, jog_update and local_jog_update flags bit 0 (path speed in velocity[0]), the local_path_samples datagram/WSS frame (distinguished from local_jog_update by its size), the lossless acknowledged path_samples slot and the path_observation slot inside the unchanged 4096-byte fast_control region, and path jog reasons appended after outside_limits_outward; joint jog, trajectories and every earlier record keep their layout and meaning. Command 266 (current-pose reference capture) was removed and is never reassigned; native refuses it as an unknown command. Direct IPC clients must be rebuilt together. HM35 and legacy anchor contracts are unchanged. Version major mismatch fails before payload interpretation. Minor 10 introduced additive cell I/O status, Halt and digital-input diagnostics appended to status and capture axes. Telemetry layout digests include nested records and reject older record layouts. fast_control max_grant_lease_ns, max_jog_input_age_ns and max_jog_first_input_wait_ns are unchanged LAN defaults, not absolute deployment ceilings. Compiled per-cell control policy supplies native enforcement; unverified absolute bounds are 10000000000 ns lease and 2000000000 ns input age. Capture V2 replaces V1; its layout version remains separately checked because telemetry admission separately checks the transitive record layout digest. Older dumps require the matching old rtctl; current readers return a typed digest mismatch naming stored and expected digests before interpreting records.

native_constants.name: PATH_JOG_MAX_SAMPLES
native_constants.comment: Path jog ring capacity in samples: generic buffer sizing, equal to engine/path_jog.hpp path_jog_capacity (1024 samples x 16 axes x 8 bytes = 128 KiB; 1 m of look-ahead at 1 mm spacing, ten times the 100 mm design look-ahead). Not a machine number.

native_constants.name: PATH_JOG_MAX_CHUNK
native_constants.comment: Samples per path_samples chunk: generic record sizing (16 samples x 16 axes x 8 bytes = 2048 bytes keeps the slot inside the 4096-byte fast_control region). Not a machine number.

native_constants.name: PATH_JOG_MAX_SAMPLE_STEP_NS
native_constants.comment: Unverified: a path sample step above axis max velocity x 20 ms is refused. At a Rosie 1430 arm's 1.396 rad/s that is 0.028 rad per 1 mm sample, about 10x the largest normal per-mm joint step, so a branch flip or near-singular jump is refused while ordinary paths pass.
